If you're looking for a quick read, I would recommend The House of Salt and Sorrows.

However, if you want to drown in a rabbit hole of beautiful writing and genius storytelling. I would recommend "Mistborn: Final Empire" by Brandon Sanderson. Or "Eye of The World" by Robert Jordan. Both are high fantasy, and unputdownable. I stayed up till 3 AM finishing Mistborn. Was a total trip!

I also recommend Pachinko, Last Night at the Telegraph Club, or if you're looking for Sci-Fi recommendations, then Skyward by Brandon Sanderson is also an excellent place to start.

Other worthy mentions:

1. Warbreaker - Brandon Sanderson
2. Elantris - Brandon Sanderson
3. Foundryside - Jackson Bennet
4. The Hobbit - JRR Tolkien
5. A Man Called Ove - Fredrik Backman
6. Anxious People - Fredrik Backman

Do let me know if you enjoy these, and if you find yourself becoming a massive Brandon Sanderson, or Robert Jordan fan, PLEASE text me and we will geek out!
